decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The planting scheme shown on drawing PR/2975/005 shall be implemented within one month of the construction of the mobile classroom hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - The proposed mobile classroom hereby permitted shall be for a 5 year period only, commencing on the 1st October 2004 and expiring on the 30th September 2009, after which time the buildings shall be removed from the school premises.

Condition : 6 - It is considered that this application for the replacement mobile classroom, would not be significantly detrimental to the appearance of the school, Conservation Area or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties for a short time period.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies C.2.1 (Educational Facilities), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Demolition of two existing classrooms and the erection of 1 x mobile classroom to existing site.
